parameters.name: frame_width
parameters.generation_rule: Frame/insert/decoration: exact affine X-scale about X=0 (dX/dp = X/frame_width_default). Lens/temple/hinge/joint assemblies: rigid outward translation of frame_width_delta/2 per side.

parameters.name: lens_width
parameters.generation_rule: Runtime calibrates the supplied NPZ basis from the measured four-dimension Jacobian, then maps ordered lens/frame X regions monotonically. Lens intervals remain affine and exact; the bridge core is isolated.
parameters.known_limitation: The authored silhouette is preserved; this parameter changes lens width and adjacent frame-region coordinates, not arbitrary product shape.
parameters.quality_metric: Serialized left/right lens widths and frame width must each be within 0.5 mm of the request.

parameters.name: lens_height
parameters.generation_rule: Runtime derives calibrated target lens-height bounds from the supplied NPZ basis and applies a positive-Jacobian Z field with smooth transitions across the authored frame rim band.
parameters.known_limitation: The authored vertical silhouette is preserved; this parameter does not infer a new contour from photographs.
parameters.quality_metric: Serialized left/right lens heights must each be within 0.5 mm of the request.

parameters.name: bridge_width
parameters.generation_rule: The control is the horizontal gap between left and right lens bounding boxes. Runtime calibration couples the NPZ basis coefficients, then constructs a monotone X map through measured bridge and lens boundaries.
parameters.known_limitation: The bridge width is a lens-box gap, not a CAD nose-bridge surface width. Full surface clearance and cross-section fit still require product-specific review.
parameters.quality_metric: Serialized lens-box bridge gap must be within 0.5 mm of the request; the continuous deformation Jacobian must remain positive.

parameters.name: temple_length
parameters.generation_rule: Affine scale along each temple's root->tip axis (LM_*TempleRoot -> LM_*TempleTip), pivoting at the root so the hinge attachment point never moves.
parameters.known_limitation: The authored temple curve is retained and its root-to-tip chord is calibrated. Temple-joint housing clearance is not certified by the chord-length check.

formula: Runtime computes J[i,j]=(measure(V0+B[j]*h)[i]-measure(V0)[i])/h and coefficients=inverse(J)*(requested_mm-rest_mm); a monotone regional coordinate field applies the calibrated target boundaries.
unified_vertex_order: matches masks.json part_masks (index ranges), which matches part_order in _part_order.json and the GLB node order
symmetry_note: All 5 basis vectors are constructed from geometry that was pre-verified as mirror-symmetric to <1e-6mm, and each rule treats Left/Right identically (same formula, mirrored sign or mirrored landmark) - symmetry is structurally preserved by construction, not just checked after the fact.
changelog: v1.2: Runtime calibration is computed from the installed basis Jacobian; frame width, lens width, lens height and lens-box bridge gap are validated within 0.5 mm.
v1.2: Coupled measurement feasibility is enforced before deformation; monotone regional interpolation preserves a positive continuous Jacobian across supported inputs.
v1.2: Per-job exact triangle self-intersection checks run in DEFIRM_PRODUCTION_MODE and are required before a result can be considered a full production PASS.
